compatibility: No user action required. FP8 remains the default target KV.
details: KV_CACHE_DTYPE=nvfp4_qsa emits --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4_qsa for the qwen38-flash-next profile and presets; other models still reject it.
The external-cache namespace includes the KV dtype, so NVFP4 and FP8 pages never share LMCache storage.
